projects.title: Amber
projects.description: A studio portrait project exploring masculinity through a cinematic visual language. Warm tones, subtle expressions and an intimate atmosphere come together to create a series that moves between strength, vulnerability and character.

projects.title: Letters from Another Time
projects.description: Inspired by the timeless world of Jane Austen, this project brings to life a romantic vision of the Regency era. Through carefully composed portraits, period-inspired styling and the beauty of natural surroundings, the series captures the grace, femininity and quiet charm of a world shaped by literature, romance and tradition.

projects.title: Sculptural Movement
projects.description: An exploration of elegance, freedom and artistic expression. A visual narrative that celebrates the beauty of movement, where spontaneity meets intention and every gesture becomes a form of expression.

projects.title: Out of Time
projects.description: A study of contrast, identity and timeless beauty, exploring the relationship between contemporary expression and the traces of the past.

projects.title: A vision of reality
projects.description:
Photography arises from the desire to represent reality. When a photographer takes a photograph, they use their experience and perspective, thus creating an image that is not merely a reproduction but an interpretation of reality itself. The interpretation of the photograph will occur without any mediation, and its meaning will be provided by the style that characterizes the reproduction, allowing you to recognize the author.

Can the photographer be considered creative or simply obedient to the camera, compelled to act in a stereotypical manner?
The mechanical process enhances the unconscious or anything the camera can record that escapes the eye unconsciously. The result is the outcome of an action embedded in the passage of time, a representation of something that existed at a given moment.
